At The ESP Tab, You Can Set Different ESP Colors For Every Player In The Game To Easily Tell Them Apart.
You Can Set A Different Key To Open The GUI.

At The Settings Tab, You Can Change Everyone's ESP Color, Reset ESP (If It Bugs Or Stops Working), And Clear All ESP Colors.

You Can Press **X** Or The **Close GUI** Button To Close Both The GUI And The ESP.

If You Encounter Any Bugs Or Issues, Please Let Me Know In The Comments.
